results.title: FastAPI + Stripe webhook signature verification
results.summary: Verify Stripe webhook signatures in FastAPI from the raw request body and dispatch on event type. Tested offline with locally signed payloads.

results.title: Express 5 + Stripe webhook signature verification
results.summary: Verify Stripe webhook signatures in Express 5 using the raw body, then dispatch on event type. Tested offline with generated test headers.

results.title: Next.js App Router + Stripe webhook handler
results.summary: A Next.js route handler that verifies Stripe webhook signatures from the raw body and handles checkout.session.completed.

results.title: Ink interactive CLI components tested with ink-testing-library
results.summary: Build an interactive Ink 8 (React) terminal checklist with useInput and a timer-driven countdown, and test frames, arrow-key and space input, submit callbacks and effects with ink-testing-library.

results.title: Stripe Node SDK Checkout Sessions with a mocked HTTP client
results.summary: Create Stripe Checkout Sessions with line items, metadata and idempotency keys, tested offline by plugging a fake fetch into Stripe.createFetchHttpClient.

results.title: Jotai atoms with React 19, tested with Testing Library and isolated stores
results.summary: Jotai 3 primitive, derived, write-only and async atoms driving a React 19 todo UI with Suspense, tested in Vitest on happy-dom with @testing-library/react, user-event and a fresh createStore per test, plus store-only tests without React.

results.title: React Email template rendered to HTML and plain text
results.summary: Build a transactional email with @react-email/components (preview, rows/columns, button, link) in TSX and render both the HTML document and the plain-text version with @react-email/render, checking escaping offline.

results.title: i18next + react-i18next: plurals, interpolation and SSR rendering
results.summary: Configure i18next with resources, plurals, context and escaping, and render react-i18next components to HTML on the server, with per-request instances.

results.title: TanStack Query + React Testing Library hooks and components (Vitest + jsdom)
results.summary: Test React components and hooks that use TanStack Query v5 with Testing Library on jsdom: fresh QueryClient per test, retries off, mocked fetchers, mutations with invalidation.

results.title: React Router 8 data loaders and actions tested with createStaticHandler
results.summary: Route loaders and actions with redirects, validation errors and 404 responses in React Router's data APIs, tested offline with createStaticHandler and plain Requests.
